messages.subject: Although joinmap reported me  two chromosomes Rqtl gives me only one !!!
parts:
I am using Rqtl to confirm JoinMap analysis, the problem that I did this

library(qtl)
mapthis <- read.cross("csv", "/home/samman/Desktop/R", "SELECTED.csv",estimate.map=FALSE,genotypes=c("A","B"),na.strings=("-"))
class(mapthis)[1] <- "dh"
newmap <- est.map(mapthis, error.prob= 0.005)

and it gives me one chromosome so I did this :

mapthis <- est.rf(mapthis)
mapthis <- formLinkageGroups(mapthis, max.rf=0.35, min.lod=3, reorgMarkers=TRUE)

and still the same

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Although joinmap reported me  two chromosomes Rqtl gives me only one !!!
parts:
est.map() doesn’t reorganize marker positions but just re-estimates the inter-marker distances.

From the data you sent, I’d think that formLinkageGroups would indicate at least a dozen markers on a 2nd linkage group. But you need to use the argument reorgMarkers=TRUE to actually reorganize the markers in the cross object.

karl
